WITH inserted AS (
            INSERT INTO organization_seller_profiles (
                organization_id,
                content,
                created_by_user_id,
                updated_by_user_id
            )
            VALUES (
                $1,
                $2::jsonb,
                $3,
                $3
            )
            ON CONFLICT (organization_id) DO NOTHING
            RETURNING id
        )
        SELECT id AS "profile_id!: Uuid", true AS "created!"
        FROM inserted
        UNION ALL
        SELECT id AS "profile_id!: Uuid", false AS "created!"
        FROM organization_seller_profiles
        WHERE organization_id = $1
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
        LIMIT 1
